collection.timing: performance.now wall milliseconds; cold first call and two warm calls in one fresh child per corpus/profile; module startup excluded; OS file cache uncontrolled
collection.memory: process.resourceUsage().maxRSS in KiB is lifetime process high-water RSS, observed after each stage; it includes TS loader and previous stages and is neither additive nor per-stage allocation
collection.garbageCollection: No forced GC; process.memoryUsage before/after is observational. Unique object/field census is a deterministic retained-allocation proxy, not V8 allocated bytes.
collection.workload: Structural preparation only. Detailed stage profile and real source/catalog entry calls are separate workloads and must not be summed together.
collection.candidateComparison: Optional --contexts: same new context adapter reused versus deliberately rebuilt actual-control, each with one cumulative budget. Separate source-owned preparation captures the authentic finite-checker source route without validation. Baseline main has neither API, so neither is a before/after semantic comparison.

largerRealTier.reason: No larger redistributable service snapshot with complete closure is present in this repository at the baseline. Weather (21,204 source bytes) is its largest WSDL. Synthetic scale is not larger-real-service evidence.

qualifications: Source snapshot hashes identify the exact measured code, including uncommitted modules; delivery commit is pinned separately in the issue handoff.
Portable artifact bytes, fingerprints and input closure are identical before/after. Source paths differ when the baseline is measured from its archived source tree.

Only retained object sharing is attributed to catalogProvenance memoization. Main-to-candidate composition also consumes the concrete charged wildcard owner; changed wildcard work is not a provenance speedup.
Context workloads compare the same new API reused versus deliberately rebuilt actual stores. Baseline main has no equivalent real-graph request adapter.

The separately named source-owned request workload uses the authentic finite-checker source preparation route without running schema validity. Baseline main has no matching API. Its source snapshot/context work is shared; loader, canonical build and resolution retain explicitly separate limits.
Default and diagnostic limits are distinct rows. Default exhaustion is a resource result, not invalid XSD or a universal negative.
Process peak RSS is a lifetime high-water observation; no exclusive stage-memory or portable throughput guarantee follows.
Logical source-stage counters retain their historical independent budgets. Each new actual-plus-candidate workload has one cumulative request budget.

sourceOwned.accountingScope: Loader runs before the shared request with its own limits. Owned source snapshot plus context snapshot/indexes share one cumulative SemanticBudget.
